title: Phase 43: UAT Findings Hardening And Closeout
description: Resolve confirmed dogfood findings, verify the complete v1.8 board workflow, and close the milestone with traceable evidence.
goal: Resolve confirmed dogfood findings, verify the complete v1.8 board workflow, and close the milestone with traceable evidence.
successCriteria: Every confirmed UAT finding is linked to a fix, regression test, or explicit deferral with rationale.
Internal bridge assets are verified not to leak into rendered Claude or Codex runtime assets.
Affected UAT steps are rerun after fixes and recorded as passing or explicitly deferred.
Focused board unit/integration tests pass after fixes.
UI build/API verification and PowerShell parity checks run when touched surfaces require them.
The milestone closes with a UAT report, requirement coverage, roadmap traceability, and archive-ready planning artifacts.
